Sen'jin Guardians are trolls that watch over Sen'jin Village in Durotar. They will appear when Alliance players approach Sen'jin Village. The guardians were among the force that defended Sen'jin Village and attacked Razor Hill during the Darkspear Rebellion alongside Vol'jin.

The Sentinel Basecamp is the second Sentinels outpost, found in northwestern Krasarang Wilds in the shadow of the Winds' Edge. To the southeast is Fallsong Village, the Field of Korja is south, and the Forbidden Jungle is to the west.
Sentinel Commander Qipan is a pandaren found at Niuzao Temple of Townlong Steppes.
__NOTOC__ Sentinel Avana is a night elf sentinel quest giver found at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale. She can provide transport to Astranaar on one of her nightsabers.
__NOTOC__ Sentinel Luara is a night elf sentinel found at Astranaar in Ashenvale. She can provide transport to Maestra's Post on one of her Ashenvale Nightsabers.
Sentinel Scout's Report can be found on the corpse of the near north of the Temple of the Red Crane in Krasarang Wilds.

Sen'jin Spirit Drum is purchased from Ravika in Durotar for during Legion: The Legion Returns (Horde) opening event. During the Battlefield: Barrens world event it was sold for 500 Kor'kron Meat.

The Sen'jin Village Outskirts is the area around Sen'jin Village. When Garrosh Hellscream discovered Vol'jin was still alive, he sent the Kor'kron to attack and wipe out the village. The outskirts is where the majority of the fighting took place.
Sentry Jienfo is a pandaren located in Tushui Landing on the Timeless Isle.
Sentry "Big Belly" Fong is a pandaren located in the Tushui Landing on the Timeless Isle.
__NOTOC__ Senior Historian Evelyna is a night elven member of the Timewalkers investigating the Timeless Isle alongside Kairoz. She is found at the Whispershade Hollow.
Sentry Dondao is a Horde vendor who sells items related to blacksmithing and can also repair armor.
Sentry Laofung is a pandaren guard at Huojin Landing of Timeless Isle.
Ku-Yao is the father of Ku-Mo. He was trapped in the Feeding Pits of Sra'vess. Ku-Yao can be seen in the Celestial Court on the Timeless Isle with his son.
Sensei's Jasper is crafted with Jewelcrafting (425); taught by trainers.

Sen'jin Villagers are Sen'jin Village citizens appearing after the battle for the Broken Shore. They are worried about the fate of their Warchief and can be seen discussing or crying with citizens from other Horde capitals.

Sentinel Hill Marksmen are level 100 marksmen found defending Sentinel Hill during the Legion Invasions. Curiously they wear clothes reminiscent of the old People's Militia, despite it having been replaced by the Westfall Brigade by that time. Marksman Redrick is presumably one of them.

Sen'jin Battle-Healers were friendly jungle troll priests from Sen'jin Village that are at the Legion Invasion locations. Once saved, they can help the adventurers. They can only be saved by Horde adventurers.
Sen'jin Shaman are friendly jungle troll shaman from Sen'jin Village that are at the Legion Invasion locations. Once saved, they can help the adventurers. They can only be saved by Horde adventurers.
Sentient Mechano Strider is a mechanostrider that is located at the Dormitory in Gnomeregan behind a secret closed door.
Sense of Urgency is a Restoration shaman artifact trait. It is linked to the Ghost in the Mist and Floodwaters traits.

Selthaes Starsong is a nightfallen located in Suramar. He was imprisoned in the Halls of the Eclipse in Felsoul Hold next to Brambley Morrison who was later moved. He eventually rescued by Angus Stormbrew and an adventurer and left the halls.
Sentries are night elf Watchers troops that protected the Barrow Deeps during the Third War.

Sentry Onatu was an ankoan of the Waveblade clan "whose watchful gaze remained vigilant until the end." His final warning saved the ankoan. They lie buried at an Ankoan Burial Shrine in Nazjatar.

The Sensitive Nodule is a found in the Digestion Chamber in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms during the Assault in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Adventurers who grow tired of the acidic nature of the interior of the Consuming Maw may wish to poke this bulb, forcing the maw to regurgitate the aggressors.

Senn is one of Turalyon's loyal lieutenants and aided him in his hunt for Sylvanas Windrunner in the Arathi Highlands. She worked with the void elf Celosel Nightgiver during this event, and Alleria Windrunner noticed that she shuddered with disgust upon exiting the void rift created by the void elf.

Sentinel Osar is a centaur located in a watch tower on the west side of Timberstep Outpost in the Ohn'ahran Plains. His bakar, Tseg, has been dognapped by the Mudfin tribe, but returns to Osar's side after Return to Roscha.

Sentinel Abakh is a centaur patrolling the road on the north side of Timberstep Outpost in the Ohn'ahran Plains. His bakar, Elaichi, has been dognapped by the Mudfin tribe, but returns to Abakh's side after Return to Roscha.
Senior Astromancer Lindeaux is a nightborne located at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken. She can be found chatting with Simon Trevel.

Sentinel Kaliun is a centaur located in Cloverwood Hollow in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

She is one of the Sentinels from Darnassus placed on the ship to protect the passengers from harm. She, however, will not attack a Horde member unless they themselves attack her.

:Aided by the Spirit of Air, a shaman may be able to see faraway objects or events, whether the distance be physical or temporal. Sentry Totem is a totem that allows the shaman to keep track of what's happening at the totem's location.

Sergra Darkthorn is an orc shaman quest giver located at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. She is in charge of the Crossroads. She is notable for being a supporter of gender equality among the Horde, praising female adventurers for having the initiative to push forward into the Barrens and warning male adventurers not to disrespect her because of her gender. Sergra assisted in the defense of the Crossroads during the Legion invasions. Sergra alongside Thork attended the first Azerothian Kosh'harg held in Razor Hill in Durotar.
Battle for Azeroth= |-| Warcraft III= Serena Scarscale is a naga sea witch who served Illidan Stormrage and Queen Azshara.

Serena Bloodfeather is a harpy found in the northwest corner of the Dry Hills of the Northern Barrens. She is the Witchwing harpies leader, and sister to the deceased Bloodfeather. She has been attacking Horde caravans out of revenge for Rexxar's slaying of Bloodfeather. Darsok Swiftdagger would like Serena to share her sister's fate.
Sergeant Major is a Legacy achievement awarded for reaching the rank of Sergeant Major in the pre-2.0 Honor system.
Sergeant Umala was an orc quest giver located in the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
Sergeant Major Germaine was a human quest giver located at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
Sergeant Stonebrow was a dwarf quest giver located in the Military Ward in Ironforge.
Seradane is an area in the northeastern part of the Hinterlands which houses one of the four entrances to the Emerald Dream, a large circular portal.
Sergeant Thunderhorn is a tauren PvP rewards vendor located in the Hall of Legends in Orgrimmar. He sells older seasons' gear in exchange for Honor Points.

In Serpent Wild, Hagar Lightninghoof sends you to Whitereach Post to seek advice from Motega Firemane. This is the second quest in the Arikara quest chain, a series of quests involving the serpent Arikara in Thousand Needles. The first quest Alien Egg can be picked up at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles from Hagar Lightninghoof.

Serpent's Coil is a winding cave system, located in eastern Blasted Lands, that had been occupied by evil cultists worshipping Kirith the Damned. Several burnt-out orcish structures stand here, remnants from the Second War. Archmage Allistarj operated his Shadowsworn forces from within this small labyrinth, that is until he was killed, now the Shadowsworn forces continue on with someone else leading them. Near the entrance is a chest with the Amulet of Allistarj inside. Deep within the cavern is a gnome named Kasim Sharim, and although he's an Alliance member he has set up a small camp within the cave with a Horde banner. When the Iron Horde began their invasion, they took control of the cav
Serrated Blades is a tier 2 talent in the Subtlety rogue tree. Maxing it requires a total of 7 points in Subtlety.
__NOTOC__ Sergeant Brashclaw is a rare gnoll found in a gnoll camp in Westfall. He is on a 2-3 hour respawn timer.

The Sepulcher, also known as the Silverpine Sepulcher, is a Forsaken base located in the western side of Silverpine Forest. The area itself lies above the Lordaeronian coastline, nestled within the surrounding hills. It was nothing more than a large graveyard and string of expeditionary caravans and individuals.
The Serpent Messenger is summoned by Magatha Grimtotem to send word to Apothecary Zamah asking for Forsaken Aid.

Sergeant Hartman is a human quest giver located in Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills during the annual Hallow's End event before the Cataclysm, and the subsequent plague-bombing of Southshore by the Forsaken.

Serge Hinott is a Forsaken alchemy trainer and quest giver located just outside the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills. He is keen to make the town habitable again for the Forsaken. Helcular and several Blightguards can be found alongside him. Prior to the destruction of Southshore he was located in Tarren Mill next to Apothecary Lydon. During the Legion Invasions, he defended Southshore.

Sergeant Yohwa is a human quest giver located in the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn. She enlists the help of adventurers to help kill Kurzen's troops, who outnumber them ten times over. The Sergeant also tries to create healing medicines for the rebels and cures for the poisons used by Kurzen's men. More recently, she has become eager to rid the jungles of the various troll tribes, which she believes are outgrowing Stranglethorn Vale.
Serpent Lake is a large lake in northern Zangarmarsh, the largest in Outland. Coilfang Reservoir is located in its center.
__NOTOC__ Sergeant Durgen Stormpike is a dwarf quest giver located in the Alliance tunnel leading to Alterac Valley in the Hillsbrad Foothills. During the Legion Invasions, he defended the entrance.
Serpentshrine Cavern is the raid wing of Coilfang Reservoir, where Lady Vashj has made her lair. It is a 25-man raid instance with six bosses, culminating with Lady Vashj herself.
Serpentbloom Snakes can be found in the Wailing Caverns. They spawn when a Serpentbloom is looted.

__NOTOC__ Sergeant Kan'ren is a blood elf quest ender located at Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods. He is harsh towards Wretched, especially the captured one that stands (and kneels) in front of him. He claims the Wretched killed two of his men in the last month.
Sergeant Altumus is a human quest giver located at East Supply Caravan in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Serpentine Sash is a world drop from level 52 - 63 Azeroth mobs.
Serenity Belt is a random world drop from level 48 - 55 mobs. It also has a significantly higher drop rate from Nefarian and Ragnaros.
Sergeant Chawni is an orc quest giver located at Stonebreaker Camp in Terokkar Forest. She is looking into rumors of a bomb created by the blood elves at Firewing Point.
Serpent Spirit's Drape is a quest reward from A Spirit Ally?.
__NOTOC__ Serathil is a one-handed axe. It is a world drop, and one of few items to be in both Warcraft III and World of Warcraft.
__NOTOC__ Serpentshrine Sporebats are sporebats located in Serpentshrine Cavern.

Serpentshrine Lurkers are fungal monsters located in Serpentshrine Cavern. They are similar to the first boss of Underbog, in that they spawn mushrooms you have to stay away from. Don't stand near those when they're blowing up. Note that they can be banished.
The Serpentbloom is located in Wailing Caverns. Looting will cause a Serpentbloom Snake to spawn.
Serpentshrine Parasites are serpents can be found in Serpentshrine Cavern.

Series Two is a term, according to Acheras the Custodian, used by titan scientists to refer to the successful second attempt at crafting a mortal race of guardians from living stone for Azeroth. The troggs (presumably Series One) were the mistaken first attempt. When the titans saw how brutal and misshapen the troggs were, they buried them in a vault under Bael Modan. The Lore Keeper of Norgannon in Uldaman mentions a second variant in its exposition, which may be the same thing, or related. The second variant matrix is the earthen who destabilized into dwarves.
__NOTOC__ Sergeant Gorth is an abomination quest giver in the Howling Fjord. He instructs Horde adventurers to attack the vrykul within the Fjord.
Sergeant's Flare is provided for the quest Towers of Certain Doom (Alliance).
The Sergeant's Torch is provided as an objective for Burn Skorn, Burn! (Alliance).
Serilas, Blood Blade of Invar One-Arm drops from Freya on hard mode in the 10-man version of Ulduar.
Sergeant Downey is a level 73 human quest giver located at Venture Bay in the Grizzly Hills.
Sergeant Hartsman is a human quest giver located at the Blue Sky Logging Grounds in the Grizzly Hills.
Sergei is a quest giver located at Silverbrook in the Grizzly Hills. He, like the other villagers, is actually a member of the Wolfcult.
Sergeant Stackhammer is a dwarf quest giver located in Zul'Drak.
An invisible ward that can see invisible units. This unit is summoned by Troll Witch Doctor's Sentry Ward spell or by the Sentry Wards item.

This infamous group of mercenaries and outcasts, led by Sergeant Bly, can be found in Zul'Farrak. They are prisoners of the Sandfury tribe, awaiting their deaths at the hands of the Sandfury Executioner. Rescuing them initiates the 100 troll siege on the pyramid led by Nekrum Gutchewer and Shadowpriest Sezz'ziz. The party has stolen the Divino-matic Rod from Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle. Bly is the one who drops the rod, so if things go sour, just make sure he is killed and everyone gets to loot his corpse before your party wipes.
__NOTOC__ Sergeant Riannah is a human found at Light's Breach in Zul'Drak.
Serissa Grimdabbler is an Alliance warlock and is one of the possible opponents for Horde in the Faction Champions battle in the Trial of the Crusader raid instance, together with her pet Zhaagrym.
__NOTOC__ Sergeant Gertrude is a Forsaken located in the Tenebrous Cavern in the Abyssal Depths.

__NOTOC__ Sergeant Flinthammer is a dwarf located at the Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh. He requests help from Alliance adventurers in defending the ranch from the Frostmane Raiders. During the Legion Invasions, he was injured but rescued by the adventurers.
__NOTOC__ Sergeant Gray offers daily quests for the Baradin's Wardens faction in Tol Barad Peninsula.
Sergeant Parker offers daily quests for the Baradin's Wardens faction in Tol Barad.

Sergeant Copperbolt is a gnome sergeant under the command of High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque. He was a part of a group that had been sent to reconnoiter Sector 17 in Gnomeregan, the location of the High Tinker's quarters.
Serendia Oakwhisper is a night elf quest giver located at Lor'danel in Darkshore.
Sergeant Zelks is a level 15 goblin quest giver found at the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara. He was present during the Legion Invasions.

Serpent's Heart is a jade statue for the Jade Serpent in the Jade Forest. Nearly complete, it has taken three generations of stonecarvers a century to get to this point. Around the great statue is an orange grove. The statue, when completed, will be used by Yu'lon to transfer her life essence into it in order to have a new guardian born. After the Horde established a truce with the Forest Hozen, Horde members scouted the area, finding and capturing a Young Alliance Soldier here. Before the statue was completed, however, the site turned into a battleground between the Alliance-aligned jinyu and the Horde-aligned hozen. Serenity Falls is a collection of waterfalls fed by Lake Kittitata in the Jade Forest and Inkgill Mere of Kun-Lai Summit. Water Sprites and Enraged Treants can be found on the nearby land, as well as Lurching Blossoms.

==General== *In an interesting twist must be fished out of his pool rather than pulled. *There is no required boss order in this zone, as there are several paths from the zone-in to Lady Vashj. The main 'cavern' is composed of a collection of large bridges and platforms above water. By using waterwalking you can start pretty much anywhere. Creative mechanics will be needed to begin waterwalking so you don't break the water when you jump down onto it (paladin bubbles, Slow Fall, etc...).
Serpentshrine Cavern Guild Run is a guild achievement that is awarded for defeating the final boss of the Serpentshrine Cavern raid while in a guild group.

The Serpent's Spine (or the Pandaren Wall and the Great Wall) is the great wall that separates the mantid territories - the Townlong Steppes and the Dread Wastes - from the Pandaren Empire. The wall is guarded by many Shado-Pan wallwatchers and has several garrisons. Roll Club: Serpent's Spine occurs here.
Septi the Herbalist is a pandaren found at Gao-Ran Battlefront in Townlong Steppes.
__NOTOC__ Serevex is a mantid located at Sik'vess in Townlong Steppes.

Serpent Stonecarvers are pandaren found in Serpent's Heart, working on the finishing touches of the jade statue of the Jade Serpent's successor. They disappear after completing Last Piece of the Puzzle.
